title: 第17章 全场轰动第18章 四九极限不五九极限
content_zh:
台下，顿时便响起山呼一般的掌声，震耳欲聋。
所有人都炙热地看着秦玄。
这个世界上，从来都是强者为尊。
秦玄虽然是新人，但一出现就展现出强绝的实力，自然得到了众人的认可。
当秦玄下台的时候，那名女侍应迎上前，目光炙热地看着他，双手恭敬地递上一张特殊的白卡，道：“秦先生，因为您战胜了单冥，获得了十积分。
另外，因为只有您押了自己胜出，所以赢下了所有的钱，共计三万一千一百二十七枚金币，已经存入了您的卡里的，请您查收。”
强者，无论在哪里都值得尊敬，何况秦玄还如此年轻，丰神如玉，更是让得女侍应眼泛异彩，恨不得能成为他的女伴。
就算是免费服侍也心甘情愿！
这张卡，乃是能够通用天下各大钱庄的卡。
因为秦玄是新人，所以斗塔发放的钱卡只是最普通的白卡。
秦玄收下白卡，对女侍应道：“麻烦帮我安排一下对手吧。”
“秦先生稍等。”
女侍应连忙道，在斗塔内，除了指定对手外，基本上都是进行斗塔进行安排对手。
否则如单冥、李维之威，在斗塔内也武斗了很长一段时间，杀出了威名，根本不是一般的真武境武修所能对付，自然胆敢挑战者相当少。
斗塔不可能任由任何一个武斗者无法武斗，因此会进行安排相应的选手。
很快，就有一名四十岁出头的中年男子被安排，成为了秦玄的对手。
很显然，这名男子可能是刚来斗塔内，并不知道秦玄的战绩，看到他如此年轻，细皮嫩肉的样子，于是道：“小兄弟，等下我会轻点出手的，不会让你受到太大的伤害的。”
秦玄微微一笑：“多谢好意了，但不需要，你还是全力出手吧。”
“既然这样，就别怪我了。”
男子也不多说，拔出利剑，舞动出一片锋利的剑花，径直刺向秦玄。

砰！
下一刻，持剑男子整个人坠落擂台下。
仅仅一个照面，这名武修就被击败了。
直到落地时，男子依旧懵然，不明白自己究竟是怎么败的。
这一切都发生得太快了。
但下方不少观众都没有意外，就连单冥这等九连胜的强有力对手都被强势击败了，莫说是一般的真武境，就算是不少真武境极限，也不会是秦玄的对手。
第三场。
第四场。
第五场。
第六场。
……
短短半天时间内，秦玄已经在人级武斗场内连胜七场！
而且，越到了后面，安排的对手越强。
其中便有两人，实力丝毫不亚于单冥。
然而，俱是登场不久后，都被秦玄照面间击败了。
content_en:
Under the stage, there was a deafening round of applause.
Everyone looked at Qin Xuan hotly.
In this world, the strong are always respected.
Although Qin Xuan was a newcomer, he showed great strength as soon as he appeared, and he was naturally recognized by everyone.
When Qin Xuan stepped down, the female waitress stepped forward to greet him, looked at him with ardent eyes, respectfully handed over a special white card with both hands, and said: "Mr. Qin, because you defeated Shan Ming, you received ten points.
In addition, because you were the only one who bet on yourself to win, you won all the money, a total of 31,127 gold coins, which have been deposited into your card, please check. "
A strong person is worthy of respect no matter where he is. What's more, Qin Xuan is still so young and as rich as jade, which makes the waitress' eyes shine with brilliance and she wishes she could become his female companion.
Even if it is free service, I am willing to do so!
This card is a card that can be used by all major banks in the world.
Because Qin Xuan is a newcomer, the cards issued by Dou Tower are only the most common white cards.
Qin Xuan accepted the white card and said to the waitress: "Please help me arrange my opponent."
"Mr. Qin, wait a moment."
The waitress hurriedly said that in the fighting tower, in addition to specifying opponents, they basically conduct the fighting tower to arrange opponents.
Otherwise, Shan Ming and Li Wei Zhiwei have been fighting in the Dou Tower for a long time and have gained a reputation that is beyond the ability of ordinary Zhenwu realm martial artists to deal with. Naturally, there are very few people who dare to challenge them.
It is impossible for the fighting tower to leave any fighter unable to fight, so corresponding players will be arranged.
Soon, a middle-aged man in his early forties was arranged to become Qin Xuan's opponent.
Obviously, this man may have just come to the Dou Tower and didn't know Qin Xuan's record. Seeing how young he was and how tender his skin was, he said, "Little brother, I will attack you gently later so that you won't be hurt too much."
Qin Xuan smiled slightly: "Thank you for your kindness, but it's not necessary. You'd better take action with all your strength."
"In that case, don't blame me."
Without saying much, the man pulled out his sharp sword, danced out a sharp sword flower, and stabbed Qin Xuan directly.
Bang!
The next moment, the man holding the sword fell down from the ring.
In just one face-to-face encounter, this martial artist was defeated.
Until he landed, the man was still confused and didn't understand how he was defeated.
It all happened so fast.
But many viewers below were not surprised. Even powerful opponents like Shan Ming, who had won nine consecutive victories, were defeated. Not to mention ordinary Zhenwu realms, even many Zhenwu realm extremes would not be Qin Xuan's opponent.
Game three.
Game 4.
Game 5.
Game 6.
…
In just half a day, Qin Xuan had already won seven games in a row in the human-level martial arts arena!
Moreover, the further you get to the back, the stronger your opponents will be.
There are two of them, whose strength is no less than that of Shan Ming.
However, not long after their debut, they were all defeated by Qin Xuan.
